input.quote: 14.1 Term. The term of this Agreement (the "Term") will commence on the Effective Date and will expire upon the earliest of (i) termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 14.2, or (ii) the date of payment of the last Approval Payment due based on all applicable Regulatory Approvals which have been received.
input.rationale: Section 14.1 sets a finite Term that commences on the Effective Date and expires on the earlier of termination under Section 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment. Searches across the document ("renew", "automatically renew", "extend the Term", "non-renewal notice", "CPI"/price increase) return no automatic-renewal, evergreen, or renewal-pricing mechanic anywhere; the only "renewal" hits are unrelated (IP registrations, permitted liens, insurance). Because renewal is not automatic, each conditional element of the preferred position (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% uplift cap) and of the fallback (60-day non-renewal window, 5% uplift cap) is satisfied vacuously, and any continuation would require a fresh mutual written agreement of the Parties. The absence of an evergreen lock-in and of any renewal uplift benefits PB, so no redline is warranted. Note only that the Agreement contains no express "renewal by mutual written agreement" statement, which is a wording point rather than a material deviation.
